# `gen.extrude_shape`: Extrude shape

Turns a flat outline with holes into a solid of a given depth, with optional round or chamfered rims.

- Category: gen
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(n log n) in outline points, plus O(n x bevel segments)
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups, creates_objects
- Also known as: extrude shape, solidify outline, extrude curve, linear extrude, fill and extrude, plaque

Give the outline as `outline` points (plus `holes`) in a `plane`, or as a `curve` object whose closed splines nest into holes and islands (its own plane is used). The back stays on the plane and the front moves `depth` along its normal: +Z for `xy` (signs, plaques, panels), +Y for `xz` (floor plans to walls and slabs), +X for `yz`.

**Groups:** `front`, `back`, `side`, and `bevel` with a bevel. Caps are constrained Delaunay fills merged into quads; walls are quads. Side edges at outline corners and sharp rims are marked sharp; a round bevel (2 or more segments) blends smoothly. Bevels inset the outline, so keep them narrower than half the thinnest part.

**Use for** signs, frames, gaskets, cookie-cutter shapes, logos, floor slabs, window panels, gears.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bevel` | `ShapeBevel \| null` | - | Rounded or chamfered rims; sharp when omitted. |
| `curve` | `string \| null` | - | A curve object of closed splines instead of `outline` (inner splines become holes); its plane is used. |
| `depth` | `Length` | `0.1` | Thickness along the plane's normal (the back stays on the plane). |
| `holes` | `[Length, Length][][]` | - | Holes inside the outline, as point lists like the outline. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Object name; a free name such as `shape_1` is picked when omitted. |
| `outline` | `[Length, Length][] \| null` | `[[-0.5,-0.5],[0.5,-0.5],[0.5,0.5],[-0.5,0.5]]` | Outline points `[x, y]` in the shape plane (closed automatically, either winding). |
| `parent` | `string \| null` | - | Parent object (name, path or id); top level when omitted. |
| `plane` | `PlaneParam` | `"xy"` | Plane of `outline` points; the shape extrudes along its normal (+Z, +Y, +X). |
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length] \| null` | - | Origin position in the parent's space. Built from a curve object, the result takes the curve's place (parent and transform) unless `parent` or `position` is given. |
| `resolution` | `number` | `6` | Segments per curved span of Bezier splines. |

## Examples

```json
{"depth":"2cm","holes":[[[-0.25,-0.15],[0.25,-0.15],[0.25,0.15],[-0.25,0.15]]],"name":"frame","outline":[[-0.3,-0.2],[0.3,-0.2],[0.3,0.2],[-0.3,0.2]]}
```

Result: `created frame (o:4) shape 0.6 m x 0.4 m x 20 mm: 16 faces (32 tris; budget 6,000)`

```json
{"bevel":{"segments":2,"sides":"front","width":"1cm"},"curve":"outline","depth":"15cm","name":"slab"}
```

Result: `created slab (o:4) shape 0.8 x 0.15 x 0.6 m: 14 faces (28 tris; budget 6,000)`
